title: What Longevity Food Protocols Is
definition: Longevity Food Protocols: diets built for long healthspans.
description:

title: Readiness Estimator: Longevity Food Protocols
definition: Estimates Longevity Food Protocols readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Longevity Food Protocols components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a protocol hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Longevity Food Protocols Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Longevity Food Protocols: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Longevity Food Protocols — diets built for long healthspans.

Phase 1 — Prove (longevity nutrients): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (protocol logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (biomarker tracking): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (research ties): protocol hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and wellness-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
